All-trans lycopene bioavailability was estimated at 23.2% using 13C-labeled lycopene in healthy adults, a high estimate for a carotenoid, but this depends on tracer/compartmental modeling and is outweighed by low systemic-availability measurements.

Therefore F >= 20% is not supported; predict low.
evidence_gaps: No direct absolute oral bioavailability record for CoQ10/ubiquinone in the evidence set.
No IV comparator for CoQ10 is available; formulation effects can be large.
High carotenoid estimates rely on labeled-tracer/compartmental modeling and are not directly transferable to the quinone-containing query.
